subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help-only for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for `openclaw tui`?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed newline insertion, but a configurable preference would add public TUI config/API surface under a repository policy that sets a high bar for new config.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in `docs/web/tui.md` and `/help` while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow TUI keybinding config or CLI surface with tests for default and customized send/newline behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Composer Work
options.body: Route configurable send keys into the broader composer/keybinding backlog alongside external editor and vi-mode requests.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in `docs/web/tui.md` and `/help` while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already made the prior keep-open decision on this issue and has the strongest current TUI/docs routing signal.
